title: Handle is LONG
text: Handle is LONG. I did not expect this pan to be so heavy.  I'm scared to even use it, I'm just a beginning cook.  I was shocked to see how long the handle was, it was like 16" long.  It almost didn't fit into my oven!  I am returning it.  I didn't realize I had to season it.  I ruined a cast iron skillet trying to season it so I'm shying away from that process.  It looks like a great pan though.  It is very heavy and advanced cooks will love it I'm sure.  I just can't get over how crazy long the handle is!
